radius.$description: M3 plain tooltip container shape: md.sys.shape.corner.extra-small (4dp) via the material3 radius scale.

padding-inline.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the tooltip component for padding inline.

padding-block.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the tooltip component for padding block.

max-inline-size.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the tooltip component for max inline size (surface size scale; to be refined in Fase M3).

offset.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the tooltip component for offset.

bg.$description: Material 3 color used by the tooltip component for background.

fg.$description: Material 3 color used by the tooltip component for foreground.

font-size.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the tooltip component for font size.

font-weight.$description: Material 3 font weight used by the tooltip component for font weight.

line-height.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the tooltip component for line height.

shadow.$description: M3 plain tooltip is flat: md.comp.plain-tooltip container elevation level0, so the shadow is transparent (replaces the inherited card elevation).

show-delay.$description: Material 3 duration used by the tooltip component for tooltip show delay.

hide-delay.$description: Material 3 duration used by the tooltip component for tooltip hide delay.

arrow-size.$description: Material 3 plain tooltips have no arrow.

bg.$description: Fill of the rich tooltip or rich popover.

bg-image.$description: Optional image layer over the rich surface fill.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter of the rich surface.

fg.$description: Ink of the rich surface body text.

heading-fg.$description: Ink of the rich surface heading over the shared fill.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the rich surface.

shadow.$description: Raised elevation of the rich surface.

max-width.$description: Maximum inline size of the rich surface.

border-width.$description: Outline thickness of the rich surface.

border-color.$description: Outline ink of the rich surface.

padding-block.$description: Block-axis inset of the rich surface, before density scaling.

padding-inline.$description: Inline-axis inset of the rich surface, before density scaling.

font-size.$description: Body text size of the rich surface.

font-weight.$description: Body text weight of the rich surface.

line-height.$description: Body text line height of the rich surface.

heading-family.$description: Typeface of the rich surface heading.

heading-size.$description: Text size of the rich surface heading.

heading-weight.$description: Text weight of the rich surface heading.

heading-gap.$description: Distance between the rich heading and its body.
